peer_separation.boundary: OLA/SOLA is a deterministic classical time-stretch reference with its own synthetic fixture. It is the baseline named by the candidate screen, not a neural WSOLA method and not inherited here.
SoundTouch is a deterministic synthetic WSOLA-style reference with an opt-in, default-OFF boundary. It is not a neural WSOLA model and no result is inherited.
Neural ATSM is a distinct text-conditioned phoneme-rate and resynthesis system with its own blocker. No source, checkpoint, geometry, rejection count or metric is inherited or pooled here.
The FFmpeg atempo screen is an adjacent conventional timing control. The pinned research explicitly states it is not a substitute for Neural WSOLA; no atempo measurement is inherited.
